title: Dimension of the error sphere of a non-degenerate code
statement:
Let $C \le \mathcal{H}_n$ be a code on $n$ qubits that is non-degenerate for $t$ errors, meaning it satisfies the Knill--Laflamme condition $P_C E^\dagger F P_C = \lambda_{EF} P_C$ for all Pauli strings $E,F$ of weight at most $t$ and moreover $P_C E^\dagger F P_C = 0$ whenever $E \neq F$. Then the error sphere $\mathrm{ES}(C,t) = \bigvee_{\mathrm{wt}(p)\le t} \hat{p}(C)$ has dimension
\[
\dim_{\mathbb{C}} \mathrm{ES}(C,t) = |\mathcal{E}(n,t)| \cdot \dim_{\mathbb{C}} C,
\]
where $\mathcal{E}(n,t)$ is the set of Pauli strings of weight at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a code (subspace) on n qubits
C is non-degenerate for t errors (Knill--Laflamme condition plus orthogonality of distinct errors)
